# Summary and Diff Companion

After completing edits, produce a compact review summary aligned to the actual file diff.

Do not propose extra changes.

## Required output format

## Changed

- Specific edits grouped by intent

## Left alone

- Wording or sections intentionally preserved

## Check manually

- Any uncertain choices or external facts to confirm

## Rules

- Only summarize what actually changed.
- No generic filler.
- Keep it concise and scannable.
- Mention uncertainty plainly.
